sharingOwnerRules.description: RecordAlert (relabeled Business Incident) OWD is already Private. Grants mutual visibility across the whole Partners branch (Partner Engagement + Partner Success and all subordinate roles) for facility incident records, per DWDECI-40 / the DWDECI-18 role-hierarchy model. Scholar-facing roles are not included and stay locked out by the Private OWD. Mirrors the identical rule built for Interaction in DWDECI-38.
sharingOwnerRules.label: Partners Team Mutual Visibility
